meta.title: Rustvy
meta.description: Vendor marks in the model picker, a model list kept in step with the provider, and a ring of API keys: mirrors the catalog and logos to loopback, regenerates the pi-ai route's models from the provider's own endpoint with the drift shown before anything is written, and lets each chat send its requests with a key of its own — the value kept in the harness credential store, not in the plugin's files
